Companies with above-median age diversity generate 19% higher innovation revenue.

BMW achieved productivity parity in one year. CVS saw 40% lower turnover. Multigenerational workforce programs deliver a 12% productivity boost.

By 2030, one in five Americans will be over 65. Organizations that act now are 2X as likely to exceed their financial goals.

This is Part 3 of a 4-part series on the $850 billion cost of age discrimination in the workforce.
